{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove the 6 QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
df_clean = df[df['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Remove refunded orders — they are not real conversions
df_final = df_clean[df_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Now filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH
new_paid_search = df_final[
    (df_final['customer_segment'] == 'new') & 
    (df_final['channel'] == 'paid_search')
]

# Compute the conversion rate
n_total = len(new_paid_search)
converted_count = new_paid_search['converted'].sum()
conversion_rate = converted_count / n_total

# Print the results
print(f'Number of NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH: {n_total}')
print(f'Number who converted: {converted_count}')
print(f'Conversion rate: {conversion_rate}')

# Return the fraction as a float
conversion_rate"}
